title: Manage help content (administrators)
content:
# Manage help content

**For administrators and power users:** add local help content for your organisation.

1. Open the `help` folder in the user profile.
2. Create a JSON file in the appropriate language folder.
3. Use the same `id` for translations.

```json
[{ "id": "my-topic", "title": "My help topic", "keywords": ["Keyword"], "content": "# Heading" }]
```

For configuring onboarding content, see [Configure onboarding when opening models](help:model-onboarding).

Store images in `help/images/` and reference them relatively, for example `![Description](images/example.png)`. New content is available after reopening help.
